title: Democratic Impact Monitor: Fast Track Judicial Access and Case Timeline Guarantee Bill
objective: Track 12-month criminal & 18-month civil trial completion rate and vacancy clearance.

indicators.name: Trial Completion Timeline Compliance Rate
indicators.definition: Proportion of cases disposed within statutory 12-month (criminal) and 18-month (civil) caps.
indicators.data_source: National Judicial Data Grid & E-Courts Portal

oversight.composition: Supreme Court judges, High Court judges, Bar representatives
oversight.powers: Statutory audit and vacancy clearance directive

triggers.condition: Exceeding 12-month or 18-month statutory trial completion limit without judicial justification.
triggers.correction: Case reallocation and trial delay compensation release
